version.changelog:
Initial release of mapbox-mcp-devkit-patterns.

- Provides integration patterns for using Mapbox MCP DevKit Server in AI coding assistants.
- Covers setup, style management, token management, validation workflows, and documentation access.
- Lists recommended tools for creating/modifying styles, token management, validation, and accessibility checks.
- Includes quick-reference workflows for pre-production validation and token management.
- Details reference files for setup, workflows, design patterns, and troubleshooting.
- Highlights appropriate use cases and key resources for developers building Mapbox applications with AI assistance.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mapbox-mcp-devkit-patterns
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides comprehensive documentation and integration patterns for the Mapbox MCP DevKit Server. It guides AI agents in assisting users with Mapbox style management, token generation, and data validation using official Mapbox resources and endpoints (e.g., mcp-devkit.mapbox.com and github.com/mapbox). No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection was found; all instructions and code snippets are aligned with the stated purpose of Mapbox application development.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only integration guide for the Mapbox MCP DevKit Server and its requested actions and configuration steps are coherent and proportionate to that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (Mapbox MCP DevKit integration patterns) matches the content: setup, style and token management, validation, and docs. No unrelated binaries, credentials, or installs are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions ask the agent to recommend and invoke MCP DevKit tools, edit per-editor MCP config files, save style JSON to repo paths, and use environment variables for tokens. Those actions are within the stated development-time scope, but the guidance includes editing assistant config files and placing tokens in env or config for self-hosting—these are sensitive operations that are expected for this skill but should be done carefully.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only (no install spec or downloaded artifacts). Self-hosted instructions cite cloning the official Mapbox GitHub repo and running npm commands, which is appropriate and traceable to the upstream project.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not require any environment variables itself. It sensibly recommends MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN for self-hosting and using scoped tokens and environment variables for runtime tokens—these are proportional to its purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent inclusion (always:false) and contains no instructions to modify other skills or global agent settings beyond configuring MCP servers for the host assistant. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not unusual here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a coherent guide for using Mapbox's MCP DevKit. Before using it: (1) only point your assistant to MCP servers you trust (the hosted URL uses a Mapbox domain but verify it if unsure); (2) prefer OAuth/hosted DevKit to avoid placing long-lived tokens in config files; (3) never commit tokens or config files containing secrets to git—store secrets in environment variables or secret stores; (4) use minimum token scopes and URL restrictions as recommended; and (5) when self-hosting, review the upstream GitHub repo before running npm install/build to ensure you're comfortable with the code you’ll run.
